Binance preliminary report reveals EIP-7702 authorization chain｜ETH risk lies in permissions and liquidation channels｜Wait and see below $2,305

My stance is not to chase the ETH rebound for now. First, separate the “mechanism” from the “price” in this security incident. On November 3, Binance released a preliminary report on the October 29 security incident: The attacker first gained unauthorized access to an internal wallet-signing service, then used Ethereum’s EIP-7702 account-delegation authorization to grant a malicious contract partial execution rights over an affected hot wallet. The report says suspending routine withdrawals does not automatically revoke malicious authorizations already written to the blockchain. The final unauthorized transfer, of 2,961.9 ETH, was confirmed on-chain at 23:56 UTC on October 29. At 00:10 UTC on October 30, Binance cleared the relevant delegated code by reauthorizing to the zero address. An independent investigation is still underway, so this report contains only preliminary findings.

I particularly reject the oversimplified claim that “EIP-7702 itself caused the theft.” The official report describes an attacker exploiting the on-chain authorization mechanism to expand their scope of operations after compromising internal permissions; the mechanism itself is also used for normal account-abstraction functions. What all custodians should really review is their signing policies, the security of their devices and development environments, revocation procedures, and how quickly multisig or MPC wallets can act in an emergency. In a notice dated October 31, the U.S. FBI attributed the incident to a North Korea-linked group and said it had observed that the stolen assets were primarily converted to ETH, with subsequent laundering potentially continuing through DeFi and instant-exchange services. This is law enforcement’s assessment of the movement of funds. It does not mean “all of this ETH has already been sold on the spot market,” nor does it mean ordinary ETH on-chain users’ assets were affected.

The market impact of a security incident comes through a combination of custodial confidence, withdrawal availability, the movement of stolen assets, and risk appetite—not because Ethereum’s protocol underwent a new hard fork today. Binance’s report says that as of October 31, 98% of the affected token assets had been replenished, and about $2.85 billion in assets had been frozen or intercepted; these figures are still subject to verification. “Replenished” and “recovered” are not the same thing. As for the market reaction, I just checked Kraken: ETH/USD is around $2,296, versus an opening price today of about $2,249, with a 24-hour range of about $2,233.51 to $2,304.60. The price is above the daily open but has yet to break the high. Farside shows net outflows of about $139.7 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 2. The data field for November 3 is still a dash, so the trailing automatic 0.0 should not be written up as zero outflows for the day. The Fed is still holding its policy rate range at 3.75% to 4%, and macro liquidity gives me no reason to increase my position size.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now, and would only consider a directionally long, unleveraged spot position, with a maximum size of 2% of net worth. I would enter in stages only if ETH decisively moves above $2,304.60, holds near $2,290 on a retest, and subsequent official security updates report no newly identified uncontrolled risks. The first target is $2,340; I would take off at least half the position there, then target $2,380 with a raised stop on the remainder. The initial stop would be below $2,265. If the price breaks below the 24-hour low of $2,233.51, or quickly loses $2,290 again after breaking above it, I would close the entire position. If official data on the security response or fund flows turns out worse, I would cancel the plan. If these conditions are not met, I stay in cash—I will never present a plan as a profit.

币安初步报告披露7702授权链｜ETH风险在权限与清算通道｜2,305美元前继续观望

我的态度是暂不追ETH反弹，先把安全事件中的“机制”和“价格”分开。币安11月3日发布10月29日安全事件初步报告：攻击者先取得内部钱包签名服务的未经授权访问，随后利用以太坊EIP-7702的账户委托授权，让受攻击热钱包向恶意合约授予部分执行权。报告称，暂停常规提现并不会自动撤销已经写到链上的恶意授权；最后一笔未经授权的2,961.9枚ETH转账于10月29日23:56 UTC链上确认，币安在10月30日00:10 UTC通过向零地址重新授权清除了相关委托代码。独立调查仍在进行，这份报告是初步结论。

我特别不接受“EIP-7702本身导致被盗”这种简化说法。官方报告描述的是内部权限被攻破后，攻击者借用链上授权机制扩大操作空间；机制本身还用于正常账户抽象功能。真正值得所有托管方检查的是签名策略、设备和开发环境安全、撤权流程以及多签或MPC钱包遇到紧急情况的执行速度。美国FBI 10月31日通报把事件归因于朝鲜相关团体，并称观察到被盗资产主要被转换为ETH，后续可能通过DeFi和即时兑换服务继续洗钱。这是执法部门对资金路径的观察，不等于“所有这些ETH已经卖到现货市场”，也不代表普通ETH链上用户资产受损。

安全事件对市场的传导，是托管信心、可提现性、被盗资产流转和风险偏好的组合，并非以太坊协议今天发生了新的硬分叉。币安报告说截至10月31日，受影响代币资产的98%已补足，约28.5亿美元资产已冻结或拦截，数字仍待核对；“补足”和“追回”不是同一回事。就市场反应而言，刚查Kraken的ETH/USD约2,296美元，今日开盘约2,249美元，24小时区间约2,233.51至2,304.60美元，价格高于日开但尚未突破高点。Farside显示11月2日美国现货ETH基金净流出约1.397亿美元，11月3日数据栏仍是横杠，不能据表尾自动的0.0写成当日零流出。美联储仍维持3.75%至4%的政策区间，宏观流动性也没有给我放大仓位的理由。

如果是我自己交易：目前不参与，方向仅考虑无杠杆现货试多，最大仓位为净值的2%。只有ETH有效站上2,304.60美元，回踩2,290美元附近守住，同时后续官方安全公告没有新增未控制风险，才分批入场；第一目标2,340美元，触及减掉至少一半，余仓看2,380美元并上移止损。初始止损设在2,265美元下方；若跌破2,233.51美元的24小时低点，或突破后又迅速失守2,290美元，已入仓部分全部平掉。若安全处置或基金流向出现更差的正式数据，我会取消计划。条件未触发时就是空仓，绝不把计划写成盈利。

#ETH

I. Analysis of Ethereum Market Trends

As of the early hours of November 4 Beijing time, Ethereum’s spot price stood at $2,295, up approximately 1.7% over the past 24 hours. Over the past five hours, the price fluctuated within a narrow range of $2,285 to $2,303, showing a generally moderate upward trend. After undergoing a significant correction earlier, Ethereum recently broke through the key resistance level of $2,260, driven by large buy orders. It is now attempting to challenge the $2,300 psychological threshold.

Looking at the moving averages, the 7-period moving average stood at $2,293, the 25-period moving average at $2,267, and the 99-period moving average at $2,264. The three averages are aligned in a classic bullish formation. The gap between the 7-period exponential moving average at $2,292 and the 25-period exponential moving average at $2,276 continues to widen, indicating that the short-term uptrend is accelerating. The price is currently above the Bollinger Band middle line at $2,270 and approaching the upper band at $2,307, underscoring the clear bullish setup.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

For the MACD, the histogram has remained positive for five consecutive periods, with the latest reading at 4.88. The MACD line has continued to rise above the zero line to 8.53, while the signal line has also rebounded from negative territory to 3.65, indicating strong bullish momentum overall. Notably, although the MACD histogram remains positive, it has narrowed slightly from 5.26 to 4.88, suggesting that upward momentum may be weakening somewhat.

For the Relative Strength Index, the 6-period RSI stands at 81.29, clearly in overbought territory, while the 12-period RSI is at 71.03, also in an elevated range. The KDJ indicator shows a K value of 80.75, a D value of 78.30, and a J value of 85.65, with all three lines in high territory. The Williams indicator reads -9.02, also in overbought territory. The simultaneous appearance of multiple overbought signals suggests that Ethereum faces pressure for a short-term technical pullback.

The Average True Range (ATR) has fallen from 15.30 to 14.62, and volatility continues to contract. The standard deviation has also dropped from 10.39 to 5.15, indicating that the market is in a low-volatility state. Such conditions often foreshadow an imminent directional breakout, so investors should closely monitor subsequent changes in trading volume.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum’s current market sentiment is marked by a widening divide between bulls and bears. On the capital-flow side, the spot market has recently seen substantial net inflows, with net buying totaling $45.1 million. Large orders accounted for $43.8 million of this, making them the key force behind the price breaking through the $2,260 resistance level. In addition, there has been positive news at the institutional level: BitMine Immersion announced that it had added 5,000 ETH to its holdings, boosting market confidence.

However, risk factors should not be overlooked. U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs saw net outflows of approximately $139.7 million on November 2, and the continued withdrawal of institutional funds is weighing on the price. On-chain data shows that the base concentration score is only around 0.006, suggesting limited interest among retail investors in following the rally. The rise is being driven mainly by large orders rather than broad market consensus.

Overall, Ethereum’s short-term technical outlook is bullish, but overbought signals are clustered, while ETF outflows pose structural pressure. If the price can break above $2,300 decisively, accompanied by rising trading volume, it may open the door to further gains. Otherwise, if volume is insufficient, the price may retest the Bollinger Band middle line at $2,270 for support. Investors are advised to watch for the potential impact of the U.S. midterm election results on the crypto market, as well as marginal changes in ETF fund flows.

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至北京时间十一月四日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报二千二百九十五美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之一点七。价格在过去五个小时内维持在二千二百八十五至二千三百零三美元的窄幅区间内震荡，整体呈现温和上行态势。以太坊在经历了前期的大幅调整后，近期在大单买入的推动下成功突破二千二百六十美元关键阻力位，目前正尝试向二千三百美元整数关口发起冲击。

从均线系统来看，七周期均线报二千二百九十三美元，二十五周期均线报二千二百六十七美元，九十九周期均线报二千二百六十四美元，三条均线呈现标准的多头排列形态。七周期指数均线二千二百九十二美元与二十五周期指数均线二千二百七十六美元之间的距离持续扩大，表明短期上升趋势正在加速。价格目前运行在布林带中轨二千二百七十美元上方，逼近上轨二千三百零七美元，多头格局明确。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标方面，柱状图已连续五个周期保持正值，最新读数为四点八八，MACD线从零轴上方持续走高至八点五三，信号线也从负值区域回升至三点六五，整体呈现强劲的多头动能。值得注意的是，MACD柱状图虽仍为正值但略有收窄，从五点二六降至四点八八，暗示上攻动能可能有所减弱。

相对强弱指标方面，六周期RSI报八十一点二九，已进入明显的超买区域，十二周期RSI报七十一点零三，同样处于偏高区间。KDJ指标中K值八十点七五、D值七十八点三零、J值八十五点六五，三线均处于高位区域。威廉指标读数负九点零二，同样处于超买区域。多个超买信号同时出现，提示以太坊短线面临技术性回调的压力。

平均真实波幅ATR从十五点三零回落至十四点六二，波动率持续收窄，标准差也从十点三九降至五点一五，表明市场正处于低波动状态。这种低波动环境往往预示着即将出现方向性突破，投资者需要密切关注后续量能变化。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪呈现多空分歧加大的特征。从资金面看，近期现货市场出现大额净流入，净买入金额达到四千五百一十万美元，其中大单集中买入四千三百八十万美元，是推动价格突破二千二百六十美元阻力的核心力量。此外，机构层面也传出利好，BitMine Immersion宣布增持五千枚ETH，为市场注入信心。

然而，风险因素同样不容忽视。美国现货以太坊ETF在十一月二日单日净流出约一亿三千九百七十万美元，机构资金的持续撤离对价格形成压制。从链上数据看，基础集中度评分仅在零点零零六附近，说明散户跟风买入的意愿不强，上涨主要依赖大单驱动而非广泛的市场共识。

综合来看，以太坊短线技术面偏多但超买信号密集，ETF资金外流构成结构性压力。若价格能有效突破二千三百美元并伴随成交量放大，则有望打开进一步上行空间；反之，若量能不足，则可能回踩二千二百七十美元布林中轨寻求支撑。建议投资者关注美国中期选举结果对加密市场的潜在影响，以及ETF资金流向的边际变化。

TVL is up… Has new money come in?

Before buying a decentralized finance project token, don’t consider an increase in “total value locked” sufficient evidence that money is flowing in. TVL measures the value of assets deposited in the protocol and is affected by their prices.

Hypothetical example: A protocol holds 100 ETH, and each unit is worth $2,000; its locked value is $200,000. If the price rises to $3,000 and the balance stays the same, the value becomes $300,000: a 50% increase with no new deposits!

For a practical check, compare TVL with asset quantities and the USD Inflows metric on DefiLlama; it calculates changes in asset balances in dollar terms, separating the effect of inflows from price changes.

The reverse is also possible: the dollar value can fall despite new assets coming in if their prices drop sharply. So don’t judge by the TVL chart alone, and don’t treat an increase in TVL as project revenue or a guarantee that its token will rise.

Source: https://defillama.com/data-definitions

content:
ارتفع TVL… هل دخلت أموال جديدة؟

قبل شراء رمز مشروع تمويل لامركزي، لا تعتبر ارتفاع «القيمة الإجمالية المقفلة» دليلًا كافيًا على تدفق الأموال. TVL يقيس قيمة الأصول المودعة في البروتوكول، ويتأثر بأسعارها.

مثال افتراضي: بروتوكول يحتفظ بـ100 ETH، وسعر الوحدة 2000 دولار؛ قيمته المقفلة 200 ألف دولار. إذا ارتفع السعر إلى 3000 دولار وبقي الرصيد ثابتًا، تصبح القيمة 300 ألف: زيادة 50% دون إيداع جديد!

للفحص العملي: قارن TVL بكميات الأصول ومؤشر USD Inflows في DefiLlama؛ فهو يحسب تغير أرصدة الأصول مقوّمًا بالدولار، ليفصل أثر التدفقات عن تغير السعر.

والعكس ممكن: تنخفض القيمة بالدولار رغم دخول أصول جديدة إذا هبطت أسعارها بقوة. لذلك لا تحكم من منحنى TVL وحده، ولا تعتبر ارتفاعه إيرادًا للمشروع أو ضمانًا لارتفاع رمزه.

المصدر: https://defillama.com/data-definitions

تنويه: محتوى تعليمي وتحليلي، وليس توصية بالشراء أو البيع ولا ضمانًا للربح.

📰 ETF Buying Spree? Why Institutions’ Sudden Buying of BTC Calls for Cautious Optimism

Creative Planning, a major ETF player, increased its Bitcoin holdings by 43% in Q3, setting off a commotion across the crypto community. Put simply, an institution suddenly went on a buying spree for Bitcoin ETFs, adding an allocation equivalent to nearly 100,000 BTC. This has a direct impact on the market’s overall direction.

Why does this news matter?
The first thing to consider when assessing the importance of institutional buying is where the money is coming from. ETFs are the most compliant way for institutions to gain exposure to crypto assets. Creative Planning’s 43% increase in holdings means institutions are increasingly willing to channel money into the crypto market through this legal route. In plain terms, it’s like a major investor in the stock market suddenly announcing plans to keep buying a particular blue-chip stock—it’s bound to attract the attention of more smaller investors. Historically, when ETF net inflows improve steadily, they often help drive gains in the spot market. This effect can be especially pronounced after a key support level is broken.

Impact on the market
For BTC, this increase in holdings has directly boosted market sentiment. In the short term, it could help establish a small support level around $77,000. Looking at the longer-term trend, however, the more important significance of this increase is that it validates Bitcoin’s positioning as “digital gold.” Why? Because global inflationary pressures remain persistent, and institutions’ willingness to allocate to Bitcoin through a compliant vehicle like an ETF amounts to an endorsement of its safe-haven properties. Keep in mind, though, that ETF capital still mainly comes from retail investors and some traditional financial institutions. The nature of this capital means its liquidity may be lower than that of direct spot trading. As for ETH, although BTC is the focus of this news, ETH, the second-largest cryptocurrency, often experiences a seesaw effect in institutional allocations. If BTC continues to rise on the back of ETF buying, ETH could also find support around $2,300.

Trading approach
This round of ETF buying is a bullish signal for BTC, but it doesn’t mean you should aggressively chase the price higher. BTC is currently trading around $77,000. If it holds this level and continues to see ETF inflows, it could challenge $80,000. But if ETF buying fails to continue, or new negative news emerges, this view no longer holds. Why? ETF inflows are fundamentally affected by the macro liquidity environment and regulatory policies. If either of these factors takes a turn for the worse, ETF allocation plans could be adjusted at any time.

[Conditions that would invalidate this view] If the Federal Reserve suddenly announces a sharp rate hike or the U.S. tightens cryptocurrency regulations, this view no longer holds.

📰 ETF加仓狂奔？为什么机构突然爆买BTC要谨慎看涨

Creative Planning这个ETF大佬在Q3直接把比特币持仓砸了43%，这动作直接在加密圈炸开了锅。简单说，就是有机构突然疯狂买入比特币ETF，规模相当于多了差不多10万枚BTC的配置，这对整个市场的风向有直接影响。

为什么这条新闻重要？
机构加仓之所以重要，首先得看这笔钱从哪来。ETF是机构最合规的接触加密资产方式，现在Creative Planning加仓43%，意味着机构端的钱通过这个合法通道流入加密市场的意愿在增强。说白了，这就像股市里某个大资金突然宣布要持续买入某只白马股，会吸引更多小资金关注。从历史来看，当ETF净流入数据持续改善时，往往能带动现货市场的上涨，尤其是突破某个关键支撑位后，这种效应会更明显。

对市场的影响
对BTC来说，这次加仓直接提振了市场情绪。短期看，可能会带动BTC在$77,000附近形成一个小型支撑位。但如果看更长期的趋势，这次加仓更重要的意义在于验证了比特币作为"数字黄金"的定位。为什么这么说？因为现在全球通胀压力持续存在，而机构愿意通过ETF这种合规方式配置比特币，就相当于认可了其避险属性。但要注意，ETF的资金主要还是来自散户和一些传统金融机构，这种资金性质决定了它的流动性可能不如直接现货交易。对ETH来说，虽然这次新闻主体是BTC，但ETH作为第二大加密货币，在机构配置上往往会形成跷跷板效应。如果BTC因为ETF加仓持续上涨，ETH也有望在$2,300附近获得支撑。

操作思路
这次ETF加仓对BTC来说是偏多信号，但并不意味着要激进追高。目前BTC在$77,000附近运行，如果后续能稳住这个位置并继续获得ETF资金流入，可能会向$80,000发起挑战。但如果ETF加仓后续跟不上，或者出现新的利空消息，这个判断就作废了。为什么这么说？因为ETF的资金流入本质上是受宏观流动性环境和监管政策影响的，这两方面如果出现负面变化，ETF配置计划随时可能调整。

【ETH rises for a day—is that a reversal? Not so fast】

First, the big platform news: Binance confirmed that the $6.3 billion hack began with a fake job interview and involved compromised AI tools. According to reports, the attackers exploited Ethereum’s EIP-7702 mechanism to target hot-wallet signing infrastructure; attribution to North Korea is not a judicial finding. South Korea’s president then said the country needs a “cybersecurity czar.” Platform security will first become a cost of trust, then feed into trading appetite and ETH risk pricing.

When watching ETH lately, my easiest mistake is to treat a one-day rise as a reversal. It’s up 1.7% over 24 hours, but down 1.9% over 7 days. What changed my mind was the Fear & Greed Index falling to 26, below its weekly average of 37, while the price still held up. This kind of divergence has often been a sign of a bottom historically, but I won’t say “we’re in the clear”—the market doesn’t reward optimism that comes too soon.

In practical terms, exchange users, ETH holders, and platforms will face higher costs for audits, insurance, and emergency response. The business case for security spending makes sense: saving on these costs might boost profits, but it could also cost you trust. Right now, I’m stuck on trading volume: can activity keep fear at bay? I still can’t read the tug-of-war between 2,190 and 2,348.

I can talk a good game, but I still get the urge to trade. What worries you more right now: another drop, or a sudden breakout that leaves you behind?

#ETH #加密市场 #SP #MarketInstinct

🚨 $6.34 billion in Binance’s biggest security breach… How did hackers deceive the platform’s employees?
What happened on October 29 was no ordinary breach, but a sophisticated cyberattack targeting Binance’s hot wallet systems and resulting in the theft of digital assets worth nearly $6.34 billion.
🔍 How did it all begin?
According to the investigation revealed by Binance today:
Hackers used fake job interviews to deceive some software engineers.
They managed to install malware on employees’ devices and steal their login credentials.
They exploited access to internal systems connected to signing wallet transactions.
They successfully carried out large transfers to wallets they controlled.
💰 How much was lost?
The stolen assets included several cryptocurrencies, among them:
233.46 million XRP
About 970,500 SOL
18,270 BTC
Amounts of ETH and OP.
🛡️ How did Binance handle the crisis?
It announced that it would absorb the losses, and users would not bear the cost.
It managed to freeze or intercept assets worth $2.85 billion.
It confirmed that it had restored about 98% of the affected assets by October 31.
📌 The takeaway:
The incident shows that the security of trading platforms depends not only on protecting wallets and keys, but also on protecting employees, devices, and internal systems.
And the most important question: Will this incident affect users’ trust in centralized platforms?

Ethereum Market Deep Dive: Technical Outlook Turns Bullish, but Overbought Pressure Should Not Be Ignored

I. Price Action Analysis

As of the early hours of November 4, 2026, Beijing time, Ethereum spot was trading at $2,295, up 1.33% over the past 24 hours and notably outperforming Bitcoin. On the hourly chart, ETH posted a steady rally over the past five trading hours. The price started from an opening level of $2,282, reached a high of $2,309, briefly pulled back to a low of $2,278 before rebounding quickly, and ultimately held above $2,295.

In terms of trading volume, 14,094 ETH changed hands in the first hour, with a trading value of $32.34 million. Volume contracted to 9,246 ETH in the second hour, then expanded to 13,189 ETH in the third hour, with a trading value of $30.24 million. This confirmed a healthy pattern of rising prices accompanied by rising volume. Over the following two hours, volume gradually declined to 5,855 ETH and 826 ETH, representing a normal consolidation on lower volume after the rally.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving average system shows a typical bullish alignment. The 7-hour moving average stands at $2,288, the 25-hour moving average at $2,265, and the 99-hour moving average at $2,263. The three averages are ordered from lowest to highest, with the gaps between them gradually widening, confirming an established uptrend. The exponential moving averages are also aligned favorably: the 7-period EMA is $2,289, the 25-period EMA is $2,274, and the 99-period EMA is $2,274. Price is holding firmly above all the moving averages.

The MACD is strongly bullish. The fast line rose steadily from 1.57 to 7.41, while the slow line climbed from -2.51 to 2.44. The histogram remained positive for five consecutive periods, fluctuating between 4.08 and 5.26, indicating robust and steady bullish momentum. The 6-period RSI peaked at 84.15 before retreating to 77.62. Although it has cooled from the extreme overbought zone, it remains elevated. The 12-period RSI is 68.32 and the 24-period RSI is 60.01, pointing to a favorable medium- to long-term trend.

On the KDJ indicator, the K value is 78.20, the D value is 77.16, and the J value is 80.29. The three lines are converging at high levels, suggesting a short-term directional move may be approaching. Price has touched the Bollinger Band upper line at $2,302, while the middle line at $2,268 provides dynamic support. The Williams %R reading of -17.97 is in the strong zone, and the Stochastic RSI at 96.32 is nearing an extreme overbought level.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum’s quantitative factor statistics currently resemble Bitcoin’s: of 15 factors, six are bullish and nine are bearish. However, the composite indicator gives a clear bullish signal, with a 75% win rate and an average maximum return of 6.6 per mille, outperforming Bitcoin’s 4.2 per mille.

On the fundamental side, continued institutional accumulation of Ethereum has drawn market attention. BitMine’s latest purchase of as many as 8,573 ETH brought its reserves to approximately 6.065 million ETH, or 4.96% of the circulating supply. Net inflows into the spot market surged to $45.18 million, including $43.77 million in net inflows from large orders. This was the key driver of the price rebound from $2,246 to $2,299.

However, risk factors should not be overlooked. Ongoing redemptions from U.S. Bitcoin ETFs are indirectly weighing on sentiment toward the Ethereum market. On November 2, institutional ETF net outflows reached $139.7 million. In addition, Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin exchange suffered a $46 million hack. The attackers transferred approximately $8 million worth of ETH to a new wallet and are suspected of moving it through a mixer. The growing frequency of cross-platform security incidents poses a trust challenge for the entire industry. The SEC’s recent statement that governance tokens are not securities, meanwhile, is positive for the DeFi ecosystem, and Ethereum, as the largest smart contract platform, stands to benefit directly.

Overall, Ethereum’s short-term technical trend has clearly turned bullish, but overbought RSI readings and ETF outflows create dual headwinds. Investors could look for pullback buying opportunities in the $2,260–$2,270 range, while short-term resistance is likely near $2,300.

以太坊市场深度分析：技术面转多，但超买压力不容忽视

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年十一月四日凌晨，以太坊现货报价二千二百九十五美元，过去二十四小时内上涨百分之一点三三，表现明显优于比特币。从小时K线来看，ETH在最近五个交易小时内走出了一波稳健的上升行情。价格从二千二百八十二美元的开盘位起步，最高触及二千三百零九美元，最低回踩二千二百七十八美元后迅速反弹，最终稳定在二千二百九十五美元上方。

成交量方面，第一个小时成交一万四千零九十四枚ETH，成交额三千二百三十四万美元；第二个小时缩量至九千二百四十六枚；第三个小时放量至一万三千一百八十九枚，成交额三千零二十四万美元，配合价格上涨形成量价齐升的健康格局。随后两个小时成交量逐步回落至五千八百五十五枚和八百二十六枚，属于正常的上涨后缩量整理。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现典型的多头排列。七小时均线报二千二百八十八美元，二十五小时均线报二千二百六十五美元，九十九小时均线报二千二百六十三美元，三条均线依次从下到上排列且间距逐步扩大，上升趋势确立。指数移动平均线同样配合良好，七周期EMA为二千二百八十九美元，二十五周期EMA为二千二百七十四美元，九十九周期EMA为二千二百七十四美元，价格稳稳站在所有均线之上。

MACD指标强势看多，快线从一点五七持续上升至七点四一，慢线从零下二点五一上升至正二点四四，柱状图连续五个周期保持正值且在四点零八至五点二六之间波动，多头动能充沛且稳定。RSI六周期指标最高触及八十四点一五后回落至七十七点六二，虽从极端超买区有所降温，但仍处于偏热水平。十二周期RSI为六十八点三二，二十四周期RSI为六十点零一，中长期趋势向好。

KDJ指标中K值七十八点二零、D值七十七点一六、J值八十点二九，三线在高位粘合，短期方向选择临近。布林带上轨二千三百零二美元已被价格触及，中轨二千二百六十八美元形成动态支撑。威廉指标负十七点九七处于强势区间，随机RSI为九十六点三二接近超买极值。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的量化因子统计与比特币类似，十五个因子中六个做多、九个做空，但综合指标给出明确的做多信号，胜率百分之七十五，平均最大回报率千分之六点六，优于比特币的千分之四点二。

基本面方面，机构持续增持以太坊引发市场关注。BitMine最新收购多达八千五百七十三枚ETH，将其储备扩大至约六百零六万五千枚，占流通供应量的百分之四点九六。现货市场净流入激增四千五百一十八万美元，其中大单净流入四千三百七十七万美元，成为推动价格从二千二百四十六美元反弹至二千二百九十九美元的核心动力。

然而风险因素同样不容忽视。美国比特币ETF持续赎回的压力间接影响以太坊市场情绪，十一月二日机构ETF净流出达一亿三千九百七十万美元。此外巴西Mercado Bitcoin交易所遭黑客攻击四十六百万美元，攻击者将约八百万美元的ETH转入新钱包并疑似通过混币器转移，跨平台安全事件的频发给整个行业带来信任挑战。SEC近期明确治理代币不属于证券的表态则为DeFi生态带来利好，以太坊作为最大的智能合约平台将直接受益。

综合判断，以太坊技术面短期转多趋势明确，但RSI超买和ETF资金外流构成双重压力。建议投资者在二千二百六十至二千二百七十美元区间寻找回调买入机会，上方二千三百美元附近存在短期阻力。

title: ETH和Gas费：一条链的油钱是怎么回事
subTitle:
转账要交Gas费、mint个NFT要Gas费，这钱付给谁了？

【本质】以太坊是一台全球共享的计算机，每笔操作（转账、交易、跑
合约）都要消耗计算资源。Gas就是你付给帮你执行计算的验证者的
「油钱」。网络越堵，大家抢着执行，油价（Gas单价）越高。

【为什么和币价有关】行情火爆→链上交易暴增→Gas费飙升。所以老玩家
有个习惯：链上操作挑深夜或行情冷清的时候，同样的操作能省一半钱。

【和投资的关联】Gas费水平是链上活跃度的实时温度计。持续高Gas=
链上需求旺盛；长期冷清=应用使用减少。把它当链上情绪的辅助观察，
挺有意思。

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Does It Mean for a Blockchain to Have Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You pay gas fees to send tokens or mint an NFT—but who gets that money?

【The basics】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (sending tokens, trading, running
a contract) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (gas unit price).

【Why it’s related to coin prices】A red-hot market → a surge in on-chain transactions → soaring gas fees. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain operations late at night or when the market is quiet. The same operation can cost half as much.

Devcon discusses faster finality | ETH rebounds but still lacks confirmation from fund flows | I’ll wait for a breakout before entering

My stance is to watch the technical developments and not chase the price for now. Ethereum’s official Devcon 8 opened in Mumbai on November 3, and the conference agenda lists a short talk by Foundation protocol researcher Yann Vonlanthen on “Finality in seconds, down from 16 minutes.” The agenda outlines a roadmap and two new proposals: one explores the trade-offs between safety and liveness, while the other introduces an accountability mechanism designed to work with single-slot finality. Improvements to the network, consensus, and validators would also need to work together. This is information disclosed in research and the conference agenda—it absolutely does not mean mainnet has already cut finality time to seconds, nor that an upgrade date has been approved.

Why should ETH traders care? Finality determines how long large transfers, cross-chain bridges, and institutional settlements are willing to wait. If waiting times can be significantly shortened in the future while maintaining safety guarantees, the user experience and capital turnover could improve. But there is still a long road from research proposals to multi-client implementation, testnet validation, community coordination, and official activation. This does not mean on-chain fees will immediately rise today, and it certainly cannot be used to directly calculate ETH’s fair price today. I care more about whether auditable code, cross-client testing, and a clear upgrade process emerge in the future than about treating a talk’s title as a trading signal.

The market has already rebounded, but the evidence is incomplete. When I checked ETH/USD on Kraken, the price was around $2,296, with a 24-hour range of approximately $2,234 to $2,305, recovering from the day’s open at $2,249. We cannot say the rise was driven by Devcon just because of the timing. Farside’s data shows that U.S. spot ETH funds had total net outflows of $139.7 million on November 2. The product columns for November 3 still show dashes, and the table’s automatic total of 0.0 does not mean zero outflows have been confirmed. The Fed’s most recent decision kept the interest rate range at 3.75% to 4%, and liquidity conditions have not suddenly eased today.

In the short term, I’m watching to see whether the price can break convincingly above around $2,305 and hold around $2,235. If it breaks above the upper level and both trading volume and fund flows confirm the move, the rebound structure would be more convincing. If it falls back below the lower level, or official technical updates show that the safety costs are too high, I’ll revise my cautiously positive view. These price levels are just current reference points and will change as new data comes in; they are not promises made at the conference.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now; I’d only consider a small spot long. The entry trigger would be a one-hour close above $2,305, followed by a retest that holds, with no new major security announcements. The initial position would be no more than 2% of total capital, with no leverage. The first target is $2,350, where I’d sell half; I’d hold the rest for $2,400, but close the position if the price spikes and then falls back below $2,305. I’d set a stop-loss below $2,260. If subsequent fund data shows continued heavy net outflows or the price falls below $2,235, I’d exit the entire position regardless of whether the targets have been reached. If the conditions aren’t triggered, I’ll stay out of the market and won’t treat this plan as an executed trade.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

Devcon讨论更快终局性｜ETH反弹仍缺资金确认｜我等突破再参与

我的态度是看技术方向、暂不追价。以太坊官方Devcon 8已于11月3日在孟买开幕，会议议程列出基金会协议研究员Yann Vonlanthen关于“从16分钟到数秒终局性”的短讲。议程介绍的是路线和两项新提案：一项研究安全与活性之间如何取舍，另一项是配合单轮终局性的问责机制；还需要网络、共识与验证者方面的改进共同配合。这是研究与会议议程披露，绝不是主网已经把终局时间缩到数秒，也不是升级日期已经获批。

为什么这值得ETH交易者看？终局性决定大额转账、跨链桥和机构结算愿意等待多久。若未来在维持安全约束的前提下显著缩短等待，应用体验和资金周转可能改善；但从研究方案到多客户端实现、测试网验证、社区协调、正式激活，还有很长的路径。它不等于今天链上手续费立刻增加，更不能直接推算出ETH今天的合理价。我更关心后续是否出现可审计的代码、跨客户端测试和明确的升级流程，而不是把演讲标题当成交易信号。

盘面已有反弹，但证据并不完整。我核对Kraken的ETH/USD时，价格约2,296美元，24小时区间约2,234至2,305美元，较当日开盘2,249美元回升。仅凭时间先后不能说是Devcon推动上涨。Farside统计的11月2日美国现货ETH基金合计净流出1.397亿美元；11月3日各产品栏还是横杠，表格自动汇总0.0不是已确认的零流出。美联储上次决议仍维持3.75%至4%的利率区间，流动性环境也没有在今天突然转松。

短线我观察2,305美元附近能否被有效突破，2,235美元附近能否守住。若突破上沿后成交与基金流向都能跟上，反弹结构才更有说服力；若重新跌破下沿，或官方技术进度显示安全代价过高，我会推翻偏积极判断。价格位只是当前观察线，随着新数据会调整，不是会议承诺。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑现货试多。入场触发为一小时收盘站上2,305美元，随后回踩守住，同时没有新的重大安全公告；初始仓位最多占总资金2%，不用杠杆。第一目标2,350美元，达到后减半；余仓看2,400美元，冲高后跌回2,305美元则平仓。止损设在2,260美元下方；若基金后续数据继续大幅净流出或价格跌破2,235美元，无论目标是否触及都全部退出。条件未触发就继续空仓，不把计划当成交。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

subTitle:
تحديث حول حادثة أمنية واجهتها منصة "باينانس" في 30 أكتوبر 2026: نتائج التحقيقات الأولية والتقدم في الإجراءات المتخذة

في 30 أكتوبر 2026 (بتوقيت المنطقة الزمنية الثامنة)، تعرضت منصة "باينانس" لحادثة أمنية معقدة، شملت أصولًا تقدر بحوالي 6.34 مليار دولار أمريكي، منها ما يقرب من 2.85 مليار دولار أمريكي تم تجميدها أو اعتراضها. تتحمل "باينانس" جميع الخسائر، وقد قامت بتأمين تغطية مالية تزيد عن 100٪. اعتبارًا من 31 أكتوبر، تم استعادة 98٪ من الرموز المميزة المتأثرة.

أظهرت التحقيقات أن المهاجمين (وفقًا لتقديرات مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي، يُعتقد أنهم من جمهورية كوريا الديمقراطية الشعبية) قاموا باختراق أجهزة الموظفين من خلال هجمات على سلسلة التوريد، وهندسة اجتماعية (مقابلات توظيف وهمية)، وبرامج ضارة. ثم استخدموا أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي الداخلية كنقطة انطلاق، للحصول في النهاية على صلاحيات الوصول إلى خدمات التوقيع على المحافظ الداخلية، واستغلوا آلية التفويض EIP-7702 الخاصة بـ "إيثريوم" لتجاوز البنية التحتية لسحب الأصول ونقلها. وشملت الأصول المتأثرة: XRP، و SOL، و OP، و BTC، و ETH وغيرها.

الإجراءات المتخذة: قامت "باينانس" بسد نقاط الاختراق، وإعادة بناء أنظمة المحافظ المتأثرة وأدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي الداخلية، واستبدال الأجهزة وتعطيل بيانات الاعتماد ذات الصلة، وتعزيز كشف الحالات الشاذة في سلوك الذكاء الاصطناعي وتحسين إدارة المخاطر الخاصة بالمحافظ. حاليًا، يتم استدعاء شركات أمنية مستقلة لإجراء مراجعات، ويتم التخطيط لإنشاء صندوق بحث متخصص يركز على أمن الذكاء الاصطناعي في مجال البلوك تشين.#SOL #BTC #XRP #ETH #OP

🌙 Late-Night Review | Early Morning, Nov. 4

Tonight’s biggest event: $BNB —Binance released its preliminary investigation report on the $6.34 billion theft on Oct. 29. The details read like a spy thriller: hackers first used fake job interviews to trick engineers into downloading malware-infected “assignments,” then abused internal AI tools to move laterally into the wallet team, hijacked the wallet signing service, and transferred assets by exploiting Ethereum’s EIP-7702 authorization mechanism. The FBI blamed North Korea’s TraderTraitor group; Pyongyang denied the allegations.

On the recovery front: about $2.85 billion has been frozen or intercepted, 98% of affected tokens have been replenished, and withdrawals have largely resumed. CZ made his first public statement overnight. On the pressure front: net outflows from exchanges reached $5.3 billion (including $15.4 billion in outflows during the week of the theft), while spot $BTC  ETFs saw more than $650 million in single-day outflows, their worst performance in six months.

Other takeaways: The U.S. and Iran sent conciliatory signals, and oil prices plunged nearly $10 a barrel in a single day; voting in the U.S. midterm elections begins today; DTCC’s tokenized Treasury securities officially went live on the Canton Network. The EIP-7702 exploit affecting the $ETH ecosystem warrants vigilance across the industry, while the RWA sector is accelerating against the trend.

以太坊市场深度分析：技术面转多，但超买压力不容忽视

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间二零二六年十一月四日凌晨，以太坊现货报价二千二百九十五美元，过去二十四小时内上涨百分之一点三三，表现明显优于比特币。从小时K线来看，ETH在最近五个交易小时内走出了一波稳健的上升行情。价格从二千二百八十二美元的开盘位起步，最高触及二千三百零九美元，最低回踩二千二百七十八美元后迅速反弹，最终稳定在二千二百九十五美元上方。

成交量方面，第一个小时成交一万四千零九十四枚ETH，成交额三千二百三十四万美元；第二个小时缩量至九千二百四十六枚；第三个小时放量至一万三千一百八十九枚，成交额三千零二十四万美元，配合价格上涨形成量价齐升的健康格局。随后两个小时成交量逐步回落至五千八百五十五枚和八百二十六枚，属于正常的上涨后缩量整理。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现典型的多头排列。七小时均线报二千二百八十八美元，二十五小时均线报二千二百六十五美元，九十九小时均线报二千二百六十三美元，三条均线依次从下到上排列且间距逐步扩大，上升趋势确立。指数移动平均线同样配合良好，七周期EMA为二千二百八十九美元，二十五周期EMA为二千二百七十四美元，九十九周期EMA为二千二百七十四美元，价格稳稳站在所有均线之上。

MACD指标强势看多，快线从一点五七持续上升至七点四一，慢线从零下二点五一上升至正二点四四，柱状图连续五个周期保持正值且在四点零八至五点二六之间波动，多头动能充沛且稳定。RSI六周期指标最高触及八十四点一五后回落至七十七点六二，虽从极端超买区有所降温，但仍处于偏热水平。十二周期RSI为六十八点三二，二十四周期RSI为六十点零一，中长期趋势向好。

The surge in Tron stablecoins may look like a sign that users love the platform, but underneath, it reflects the fragmentation of crypto payment infrastructure. In the past, everyone used Ethereum to move stablecoins around. Now Tron has suddenly risen to prominence. What does this mean? Put simply, the crypto payments landscape is about to change. Why? Because Tron has proven that it’s not just a blockchain—it’s also a payment gateway that can outperform Ethereum. This is driven by the market’s pursuit of speed and lower costs: Tron’s fees are indeed cheaper than Ethereum’s, and the user experience is better. But this growth is more like a signal that “crypto payments are moving away from Ethereum’s centralized hub toward a future with multiple parallel routes.”

Impact on the market

What direct impact does this have on BTC and ETH? Honestly, in the short term, it could give BTC’s safe-haven appeal a boost, since more stablecoins mean greater market liquidity. But the long-term trend remains unchanged: ETH still needs to deliver on its Web3 narrative. The deeper impact is that regulators may take notice of this “new player.” If Tron continues to grow, regulators may have to reassess their approach to regulating stablecoin platforms. A similar event from the past? When Tether nearly collapsed, it almost dragged down the entire Ethereum ecosystem. This time, Tron’s complete reliance on USDT is cause for concern. When leaving France, do you have to pay tax upfront on unrealized gains in your crypto holdings? This time, the National Assembly rejected both “crypto exit tax” proposals.

According to National Assembly voting records and several news reports, while examining the revenue section of France’s 2027 budget, the National Assembly rejected two amendments that would have brought crypto assets under the “exit tax” (impôt de sortie). This wasn’t about “paying tax only when you sell,” but about “taxing unrealized gains on assets you haven’t sold when you move your tax residence abroad.”

A few points that matter directly to ordinary people 👇

🔹 Which two proposals were rejected? One (by Sansu and others) would have included crypto assets in the tax base of the existing exit tax. It received about 27 votes in favor, 55 against, and 1 abstention. The other (by Bouloux) would have taxed unrealized gains for people leaving France who had more than €800,000 in crypto assets across their household and had been French tax residents for at least six of the previous ten years. It received about 31 votes in favor and 60 against. Neither passed.

🔹 What does the exit tax cover now? France’s current exit tax mainly targets assets such as shares and securities. When tax residents move their tax residence abroad, they may be taxed on “paper gains” (with mechanisms such as deferred payment and relief for returning to France often available). Directly held crypto assets have not previously been covered by the same framework, which is why some lawmakers wanted to close the gap. This time, a majority rejected the proposals to do so.

🔹 What does this mean for retail investors? If you’re simply buying and selling in France, converting crypto to euros, or spending it, the existing rules for realized gains generally still apply (individuals commonly face a flat withholding tax rate of around 30%, subject to the tax authorities’ interpretation). It does not mean you “pay exit tax every day just for holding.” What was rejected was the plan to tax you on unrealized gains when you leave the country, even if you haven’t sold your crypto.

🔹 What’s still up in the air? Votes on the revenue section of the 2027 budget have been postponed several times, and the deadline for the first reading is approaching (reports point to midnight on November 17). Other amendments—on reporting large self-custodied holdings, exempting small crypto payments from tax, and whether converting crypto into fiat-pegged stablecoins counts as a taxable event—are still under discussion or have been considered earlier. Whether any of them ultimately becomes law depends on the rest of the legislative process.

In short: the two proposals for an “exit tax on unrealized gains” failed. That doesn’t mean France’s crypto taxes have disappeared. Everyday obligations around selling, converting, and reporting still apply; what has been dropped for now is the requirement to pay tax on unrealized gains when moving abroad.

Would the rejection of the exit tax make you more comfortable holding crypto long-term in France, or are you more concerned about the rules for converting to stablecoins? Let’s discuss in the comments 👇

#法国否决两项加密退出税提案 #BTC #ETH

content:
离开法国时，手里浮盈的币也要先交一笔税？国民议会这回把两条「加密退出税」都否了。

据国民议会表决记录与多家报道，法国国民议会在审议 2027 年预算收入部分时，否决了两项把加密资产纳入「退出税（exit tax / impôt de sortie）」的修正案——不是「卖币才交」，而是「搬走税籍时，对还没卖掉的浮盈先计税」。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 被否的是哪两条：一条（Sansu 等）要把加密资产并入现行退出税税基，票数约 27 赞成、55 反对、1 弃权；另一条（Bouloux）针对「家庭加密资产合计超过 80 万欧元、且近十年里至少六年是法国税务居民」的离境者，对未实现浮盈征税，约 31 赞成、60 反对。两条都没过。

🔹 退出税本来管什么：法国现行退出税主要盯的是股权、证券一类资产——税务居民把税籍迁到国外时，可能要对「账面浮盈」征税（常有缓缴、回国减免等机制）。直接持有的加密资产过去不在同一套框里，所以才有议员想补洞；这次补洞提案被多数否决。

🔹 对零售意味着什么：如果你只是在法国境内买卖、把币换成欧元或消费，一般仍按现行已实现收益规则走（个人常见是约 30% 档的统一预扣税体系，具体以税务口径为准），并不是「持仓不动也天天交退出税」。被否掉的，是「人走了、币还没卖，也要按浮盈先算一笔」那套离境设计。

🔹 什么还没完：2027 预算收入部分表决已多次推迟，一读期限临近（报道指向 11 月 17 日午夜前）；另有自托管大额申报、小额加密支付免税、以及早前「兑成法币锚定稳定币是否视同应税」等修正案仍在或曾进入讨论，是否最终成法还要继续走程序。

说白了：这次是「离境浮盈税」两条提案过不了关，不等于法国加密税没了。卖出、兑换、申报这些日常义务还在；真正松的是「搬家先交未实现收益」这一刀。

你会因为离境税被否而更敢在法国长持，还是更关心稳定币兑换那条？评论区聊聊👇

Early hours of November 4, 2026 · Market Recap

I. Current Outlook: A Rebound After Finding Support, but Still Range-Bound

BTC is showing short-term signs of finding support: the October 31 low of 76,253 was tested for a second time during the day without breaking, and the 1-hour candle closed back above yesterday morning’s high of 77,310. The 4-hour chart formed a bullish engulfing pattern, and price is currently moving upward within the 4-hour range of 76,253–78,820.

However, overhead resistance is also clear: two attempts to break higher last night, to 77,836 and 77,790, both failed. The daily chart remains relatively weak: price is still below the October 24 low of 79,170, and the daily MACD fast line continues to move downward. Most of the positions added during yesterday’s decline remain open, suggesting neither bulls nor bears have backed down and a directional move may be near.

II. What to Watch Next

Signs of strengthening: First, watch whether price can break above 77,800. A 4-hour candle close above 78,800 would signal that the short-term outlook is starting to improve.

Signs of weakening: A 4-hour candle close below 76,300 could lead to another leg down, with the 76,100–75,900 area in focus below.

III. Key Levels

Key level: 76,300
Daily bull-bear dividing line: 82,600
Resistance above: 77,800, 78,800, 79,200
Support below: 77,300, 76,100, 74,900

IV. Summary

BTC has rebounded after finding support within the 76,253–78,820 range. In the short term, watch for a break above 77,800 and a sustained 4-hour close above 78,800. If a 4-hour candle closes below 76,300, the rebound will be invalidated, with 76,100–75,900 as the next downside target. On the daily chart, price remains below 79,170 and the MACD is bearish. For now, this is a corrective rebound within a range, with no confirmed trend reversal.

📰 Why Have Solana’s Stock Tokens Surged 3.5x?

Stock tokens on Solana have surged 3.5x since the beginning of the year, signaling growing market interest in blockchain-based securities that could fundamentally change how traditional finance operates. These tokens essentially record information about company shares on a decentralized blockchain, allowing investors to trade stocks much like they would cryptocurrencies.

Why does this matter?

Three key factors are behind the surge: First, Solana’s low costs and high throughput address efficiency bottlenecks in traditional securities trading. Second, institutional investors are looking for “stable assets” in the crypto world, and stock tokens may offer just that. Third, demand for stocks among non-U.S. investors in the Reg S-b market has surged, and on-chain tokens are filling that gap. This means blockchain is expanding beyond speculation into asset allocation.

Market impact

The direct impact on major cryptocurrencies appears limited for now, but there are three potential long-term ripple effects: First, more traditional publicly traded companies may launch tokens on the blockchain. Second, centralized exchanges and custody platforms may develop on-chain stock trading features. Third, regulators may reassess “decentralized securities.” Historically, whenever technology has addressed a pain point in traditional finance, it has triggered disruptive industry growth.

💡 The continued rise of Solana stock tokens reflects the gradual acceptance of crypto asset allocation by institutional investors. However, it’s worth watching out for a potential reversal if the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ramps up its scrutiny of Decentralized Finance in the near term. If the regulatory environment remains favorable, this growth trend could continue through the end of the year.

Solana上的股票代币自年初以来暴涨3.5倍，这表明市场对区块链证券的兴趣日益浓厚，可能从根本上改变传统金融的运作方式。这类代币本质上是公司股票的信息记录在去中心化链上，让投资者能像持有加密货币一样操作股票。

translatedData.subTitle:
The biggest misconception beginners have: if you’re not holding a position, you’re not trading. So they stay fully invested, constantly buying and selling,
until fees and market swings wear away their capital.

In reality, being flat is the only position with zero losses. If you don’t understand the market, stay flat,
Staying flat when bulls and bears are battling it out, and staying flat after a few losing trades in a row— the money you save in these three situations,
is more than most people make from trading.

We’ve all heard the hunting metaphor too many times, but the lesson is true: hunters spend most of their time waiting. Pulling the trigger
takes just a second. If you have capital on hand, you’ll have bullets when an opportunity comes along. Hold on to your bullets.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | What Matters More Than Predicting the Market: Reviewing Your Own Trades
translatedData.subTitle:
Most people spend 90% of their time predicting the market and 0% reviewing their own behavior. They’ve got it backwards.

Write down three things for every trade: why you entered (your rationale), what went wrong or right (execution),
and what you’ll change next time (specific actions). Stick with it for a month, and you’ll be shocked to discover that your losses…
Your trade log is full of the same mistakes repeating—for example, always reversing your position right after a stop-loss,
or never letting profitable trades run.

The market changes, but your behavioral patterns won’t change on their own unless you watch them and work on them. The market is the most
honest teacher, and your trade records are your report card. Don’t just look at your account balance—review your trade history.

Bitcoin edged up slightly as U.S. stocks opened, holding the $76,000 level, but market sentiment showed no clear improvement. Analysts believe U.S. stocks fell because investors are concerned that the U.S. midterm elections could lead to political deadlock. This uncertainty is driving money out of tech stocks. Although Bitcoin has found temporary support, the weakness in stocks suggests risk appetite has not improved.

Why does this news matter?
The key takeaway is that market sentiment is complex. On the one hand, Bitcoin can find short-term support as a safe-haven asset when stocks are volatile. On the other hand, if political uncertainty persists, it could put further pressure on risk assets, including Bitcoin. This reflects the link between crypto markets and the macroeconomy: the effects of political events are spreading from traditional markets into crypto.

For the industry, this means Bitcoin’s support comes not only from technical factors, but also from macro fund flows. Recent U.S. CPI data came in as expected, but strong employment data weakened expectations of Fed rate cuts. This economic divergence is widening the gap between different parts of the stock market, while the crypto market has yet to fully absorb its effects.

Market impact
In the short term, Bitcoin holding $76K shows that bulls are trying to contain the decline. But if U.S. stocks remain under pressure, Bitcoin could face the risk of retesting its lows. As for ETH, although it has posted larger gains, weak sentiment in the stock market could also curb its upward momentum. Fund flow data shows that tech funds have recently seen $1.7 billion in redemptions. Some of this money could flow into traditional crypto assets such as Bitcoin, but the amount is not yet enough to reverse the market trend.

A similar historical event occurred during the 2022 U.S. Capitol riot, when Bitcoin briefly rose but then fell as market confidence recovered slowly. The current political deadlock could last longer than the riot, so its impact may also be more far-reaching.

Trading outlook
Bitcoin is currently at $77,765, within a consolidation range. If U.S. stocks continue to weaken amid the political deadlock, this support level could be tested. However, if U.S. economic data remains strong, Bitcoin could benefit from safe-haven demand. This outlook would no longer apply if the Fed maintains its high-interest-rate policy.

比特币在美股开盘时小幅上涨，守住$76,000关口，但市场情绪并未明显改善。分析师认为，美股下跌是因为投资者担心美国中期选举可能带来的政治僵局，这种不确定性让资金从科技股撤离。虽然比特币暂时获得支撑，但股市的疲软暗示风险偏好并未改善。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这条新闻的关键在于揭示了市场情绪的复杂性。一方面，比特币作为避险资产，在股市动荡时能获得短期支撑；但另一方面，如果政治不确定性持续，可能会进一步打压风险资产，包括比特币。这反映了加密市场与宏观经济的联动性，政治事件的影响正在从传统市场传导到加密领域。

对行业而言，这意味着比特币的支撑不仅仅来自技术面，还与宏观资金流向有关。近期美国CPI符合预期但就业数据强劲，让美联储降息预期减弱，这种经济分歧正在加剧股市分化，而加密市场尚未完全消化这一影响。

对市场的影响
短期看，比特币守住$76K显示多头在尝试控制跌势，但若美股持续承压，比特币可能面临二次探底风险。对ETH而言，虽然涨幅更大，但股市情绪低迷也会抑制其上涨动力。资金流向数据显示，科技基金近期面临17亿美元赎回，这部分资金可能流向比特币等传统加密资产，但规模尚不足以逆转市场趋势。

历史类似事件包括2022年美国国会骚乱时比特币曾短暂上涨，但随后因市场信心恢复缓慢而下跌。当前的政治僵局可能比骚乱更持久，因此影响也可能更深远。

操作思路
目前比特币$77,765的位置处于震荡区间，如果美股在政治僵局中继续走弱，这个支撑位可能会被测试。但若美国经济数据持续强劲，比特币可能受益于避险需求。不过，如果美联储维持高利率政策，这个判断作废。

Ethereum Foundation updates public infrastructure resources | Bhutan identity case is an earlier development | ETH confirms at 2304.60

My stance is cautious observation; I would not directly convert the long-term narrative of “public sector adoption of Ethereum” into buying pressure tonight. On November 3, the Ethereum Foundation published an article on digital public infrastructure and launched a resource website for institutions such as governments and NGOs. It focuses on how shared networks can let different parties independently verify records while retaining control over their own data and policies. This is the new action confirmed today: a publication and a resource portal—not an announcement that a country signed a new procurement contract today, much less a commitment by the Foundation to buy ETH.

Bhutan’s national digital identity system, cited in the article, is worth reading closely, but the timeline needs to be clear. Bhutan NDI officially announced its Ethereum integration as early as October 13, 2025; the Foundation listing it as a case study today does not mean it was only put on-chain today. The system lets individuals hold digital credentials in their wallets, while an on-chain shared registry mechanism is used to verify the issuer and the credentials’ authenticity. Individuals’ sensitive information does not need to be publicly written on-chain. The Foundation also described a proof of concept for humanitarian aid coordination; this is still a proposed solution being tested, not something that can be said to have been deployed at scale. The public infrastructure narrative can broaden institutions’ understanding of Ethereum, but actual transaction volume, fees, and ETH value capture will depend on real usage frequency and on-chain settlement methods going forward; presenting an identity credential does not necessarily generate a mainnet transaction each time.

As for the market reaction, Kraken ETH/USD was around $2286.55 just now, up from the daily open of $2249.46, with an intraday range of $2233.51 to $2304.60. The recovery has already happened, but the intraday high has not yet been broken, so it cannot be concluded that the rise was driven by the Foundation’s article simply because they appeared on the same day. Flows also offer no confirmation of a tailwind: Farside reported net outflows of $139.7 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 2; on November 3, the figures for individual funds are still dashes, and the automatically displayed total of 0.0 should not be treated as confirmed zero flows. On the macro front, the Federal Reserve’s latest statement still keeps the target interest rate at 3.75%–4%; in a high-rate environment, it is especially important to see whether funds actually flow back in.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot long position, with no leverage. The entry trigger is for ETH to break and hold above $2304.60, then successfully retest that level, while the next complete fund-flow report no longer shows clear deterioration; if either condition is missing, I would remain flat. If triggered, I would use no more than 2% of total capital, first target $2340, where I would sell half, then look to $2380; I would place the initial stop at $2260 and close early if the price falls back below $2249.46 or if official facts are materially revised. If it breaks below $2233.51 outright, tonight’s rebound thesis is invalidated, and I would not average down. Public-sector implementation is a long-term item to watch; trades should be made only when confirmed by price and fund flows.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

以太坊基金会更新公共基建资料｜不丹身份案例是旧进展｜ETH等2304.60确认

我的态度是谨慎观察，不把“公共部门采用以太坊”的长期叙事直接换算成今晚的买盘。以太坊基金会11月3日发布数字公共基础设施文章，同时推出面向政府、非政府组织等机构的资料网站，重点讨论共享网络如何让各方独立核验记录，并保留对各自数据和政策的控制。这是今天可确认的新动作：发布说明和资源入口，而不是宣布某个国家今天签了新采购合同，更不是基金会承诺买入ETH。

文章引用的不丹国家数字身份系统值得细读，但时间线要摆正。不丹NDI官方早在2025年10月13日便公布与以太坊集成；今天基金会把它列为案例，不代表今天才上链。该系统让个人在钱包里持有数字凭证，链上共享登记机制用于核验发行方与凭证真实性，个人敏感信息不必公开写进链上。基金会还介绍人道援助协调的概念验证，这仍是验证方案，不能说成已经大规模部署。公共基础设施叙事能扩大机构理解以太坊的范围，但实际交易量、手续费和ETH价值捕获，要看后续真实使用频率与链上结算方式；每次出示身份证明不一定都产生一笔主网交易。

市场反应方面，Kraken ETH/USD刚才约2286.55美元，较日开2249.46有所回升，日内区间2233.51至2304.60。回升已经发生，却还没有突破日内高点，不能仅凭同一天出现基金会文章就断言上涨由文章驱动。资金面也没有给出顺风确认：Farside统计11月2日美国ETH现货基金净流出1.397亿美元，11月3日各基金尚为横杠，自动显示的合计0.0不能当作已确认零流量。宏观上，美联储最近一次声明仍把目标利率维持在3.75%至4%，高利率背景下更需要看资金是否真正回流。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向仅考虑现货轻仓做多，不做杠杆。入场触发是ETH有效站上2304.60美元、回踩不破，同时下一次完整基金流向不再明显恶化；两项缺一就继续空仓。触发后最多用总资金2%，先看2340美元，抵达后减半，再看2380美元；初始止损放在2260美元，跌回2249.46下方或官方事实出现重大修正时提前平仓。若直接跌破2233.51，今晚的反弹判断被推翻，不向下摊平。公共领域落地是长期观察项，交易只按价格与资金确认执行。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

📰 Russia’s Exchange Makes Its Move at Year-End: What Will Crypto Regulation Actually Look Like?

The Moscow Exchange plans to launch trading in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether on December 1. It will comply with the country’s newly passed investor-protection regulations, which set annual purchase limits for ordinary retail investors. This marks a new step for both Russia’s domestic crypto market and the global regulatory landscape.

Why does this news matter?
As Russia’s largest exchange, the Moscow Exchange’s entry into crypto trading means the country is systematically bringing cryptocurrencies into its regulatory framework. This reflects Russia’s aim to reduce its dependence on Western finance, attract capital inflows, and manage financial risks. The investor-protection measures set out in the new law—such as annual purchase limits—are essentially intended to prevent ordinary investors from losing everything amid the crypto market’s sharp swings. Globally, this continues Russia’s recent approach of “embracing while restricting” crypto regulation, echoing the tightening regulatory direction in the EU, the United States, and elsewhere, although the details of implementation vary considerably.

Market impact
For BTC and ETH, this is a positive catalyst. On the one hand, Russia is a major holder of cryptocurrencies globally, and the exchange’s official launch could further boost the circulation of Bitcoin and Ethereum in the country and strengthen their role in price discovery. On the other hand, regulatory compliance often helps bolster market confidence, especially as major economies gradually accept crypto assets. Historical data shows that liquidity in relevant assets typically improves when regulations become clearer. However, it’s worth noting that Russia’s market is unusual in that it may be somewhat disconnected from international markets. This means that even if domestic activity picks up, international price movements for BTC and ETH will likely continue to dictate their short-term direction.

Trading outlook
I believe the Moscow Exchange’s official launch will provide modest bullish momentum for BTC and ETH, particularly in the short term. However, this outlook depends on Russia not subsequently imposing more aggressive capital controls to restrict cross-border crypto flows. If that happens, or if the international community tightens sanctions on Russia’s crypto market further, this bullish thesis could be undermined.

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH而言，这是一个正面的催化剂因素。一方面，俄罗斯是全球加密货币重要持有国，交易所的正式上线能进一步促进该国比特币和以太坊的流通和定价权重。另一方面，合规化进程往往伴随着市场信心的提振，尤其是当主要经济体逐步接受加密资产时。历史数据显示，监管清晰化后，相关资产的流动性通常会改善。不过需要注意，俄罗斯市场的特殊性在于其与国际市场的联动可能存在隔离效应，这意味着即使国内市场活跃，BTC和ETH的国际价格走势仍会主导短期方向。

translatedData.subTitle:
On emotional days, you can forget every lesson, so I wrote these down and stuck them up:

First: Write down your stop-loss level before entering a trade. If you can’t, don’t enter.
Second: Never risk more than 2% of your capital on a single trade. No exceptions.
Third: Never add to a losing position or average down.
Fourth: After three losses in a row, stop trading for the day. Watch, but don’t trade.
Fifth: Withdraw some of your profits. Taking money out helps keep your mindset steady.

Just five rules, and not one is about “how to read the market.” Because the reason people lose big money is never

translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who truly hold on to their gains in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days a year turns your money into 12 times as much; steadily earning 10% a month
turns it into 30 times as much over three years. It may not sound thrilling, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. Market conditions are something you wait for; discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market;
the ability behind the second is yours. The market opens every day, but only those who preserve their capital get to keep playing.

📰 Why Didn’t the U.S. Election Results Change BTC’s Downtrend? This CEO Sees Through the Macro Picture

The U.S. election results are in, and the market expects them to be bullish for Bitcoin. But the GSN CEO poured cold water on that outlook: tight macro liquidity and regulatory uncertainty are the core factors weighing on BTC. The CEO made it clear that elections are only short-term sentiment catalysts and won’t reverse long-term pressures.

Why does this news matter?
This warning gets to the heart of the industry: crypto is always at the mercy of the macro environment. Regardless of a country’s election results, the ultimate factors determining whether Bitcoin can reach higher levels are whether global capital is flowing in or out and whether regulations around the world are tightening or easing. Election results may temporarily satisfy some investors’ sentiment-driven hopes, but the fundamental tensions remain. Why does this matter? Because it explains why even good news may not push BTC prices higher—the market isn’t foolish; short-term speculation and long-term value are two different things.

Market impact
In the short term, the election results could spark a sentiment-driven rebound in BTC prices, but the GSCEO’s warning suggests that any such rebound may be short-lived. If the Federal Reserve continues raising rates, the U.S. fiscal deficit grows, or financial risks emerge somewhere in the world, any positive effects from the election could quickly be erased. In terms of the broader landscape, regulators won’t suddenly let crypto grow unchecked just because of the election results, so compliance pressures may persist. As for capital flows, if global liquidity really does tighten, even if some funds move into crypto from other markets, the total may not be enough to support a major rise in BTC.

Trading outlook
Honestly, trying to predict how much BTC can rise right now is just guesswork. The GSN CEO’s view suggests that if the Fed continues to send hawkish signals over the next few weeks, or a European country runs into debt problems, then the current $77K level is a high-altitude zone. That outlook may change only if the world’s major central banks really do pivot toward easing. In short, there are still plenty of reasons to be bearish unless the macro environment fundamentally improves. If a U.S. fiscal cliff really hits and triggers global risk aversion, that could create a potential opportunity for BTC—but the odds are low.

美国中期选举结果对全球资金流向影响巨大，但这次和以往不同的是，投资者发现风险资产里连科技股都不安全（苹果利润预期下滑14%）。比特币的第五周阴线直接把$85,000这个心理防线给击穿了。为什么？因为大家发现现在不光要防地缘政治和监管，还得防供应链风险——苹果这种大厂都开始喊成本危机，那更别提小币圈了。

对市场的影响
短期看，只要选情没结果，比特币大概率还得在$76,000-$78,000区间里震荡。但选情不确定性意味着这个区间可能缩得更短。历史上看，每次美中期选举期间，比特币都会出现类似现象：2020年选举周跌了9%，2018年也跌了12%。这次不同的是，美联储还在加息预期中（当前30年期美债收益率5.216%），这意味着即使选情明朗，风险资产也可能没多少反弹动力。

操作思路
选情不确定性期间，比特币大概率会继续承压。观察点在于$75,000这个整数关口，如果跌破可能触发更大抛压。但这个判断的前提是市场情绪继续悲观，如果选举结果出现超预期利好（比如民主党大幅获胜且承诺监管松绑），那这个阴线行情可能会突然拐头。

ETH is down 0.42% today, with the current price at 2280.3. That number carries almost no information. What could really sway the circulating supply over the next few weeks is another figure: 530,000.

First, what does this 530,000 refer to? The attacker’s wallet holds more than 530,000 ETH, about 0.44% of ETH’s circulating supply, as well as more than 18,000 BTC. The wallet’s total assets are worth around $5.5 billion. What makes these holdings unusual isn’t their size, but the fact that they come with no restrictions: no unlock schedule, no vesting period, no disclosure obligations, and no legal document preventing them from appearing in an exchange deposit address tomorrow. With a project treasury unlock, the market can at least count down to the date. With this wallet, it’s simply “whenever the holder decides.” At 2280, 530,000 ETH represents a nominal value of about $1.2 billion, or roughly 18% of the 24-hour trading volume of 6.695 billion USDT. Dumping that much all at once isn’t realistic; slippage would eat up more than half the seller’s returns. More likely options are discounted over-the-counter sales, splitting it into smaller batches, or simply holding it long term as a bargaining chip.

But the market clearly isn’t pricing this in right now. The 24-hour trading volume is 6.695 billion USDT, while the price has moved just 0.42%—a very quiet drop. The derivatives market tells a different story: open interest remains firmly at 5.378 billion USDT, and 70.5% of accounts are long. In other words, of every ten accounts with perpetual futures positions, seven are on the same side. It’s important to distinguish account share from position share: having more retail accounts doesn’t mean the nominal long exposure is larger. But it does point to one thing: if an on-chain alert such as “suspicious activity from a hacker address” appears, stop-losses will be heavily clustered within the same price range. Crowding itself is a risk; whether the direction is right is another matter.

Now consider the cost of leverage. The 8-hour funding rate remains pinned at the full +0.0100% benchmark, or about 11% annualized. This reading shows that longs are still paying to hold their positions, with no sign of retreat. Paying double-digit annualized rent while accounts are overwhelmingly on one side is a combination that signals “bullish sentiment” in calm conditions, but “a chain reaction” when a shock hits.

So what you should really be watching isn’t today’s small red candle, but one address. Any transfer from the main wallet holding those 530,000 ETH—especially to a known exchange deposit address—would send a signal sooner than the candlestick chart or funding rate. Until that signal appears, the area around 2280 looks more like a range with an invisible ceiling overhead and clustered stop-losses below than a place where it’s safe to make a confident one-way bet.

When the time comes to act, the blockchain won’t give you advance notice. The only difference is whether your position size makes you a spectator or the one getting stopped out.

但市场现在明显没在定价这件事。24 小时成交额 66.95 亿 USDT，价格只挪了 0.42%，跌得非常安静。而合约端是另一幅图景：持仓量 53.78 亿 USDT 还稳稳挂着，多头账户占比 70.5%——开永续的账户里每十个有七个站在同一边。这里要区分清楚，账户占比不等于仓位占比，散户账户多不代表多头名义敞口大，但它确实反映了一件事：一旦出现“黑客地址异动”这类链上推送，止损会高度集中在同一段价格区间里。拥挤度本身就是一种风险，方向对不对是另一回事。

Hong Kong bank settlement enters 24/7 pilot｜ETH chain unspecified｜I’m waiting for evidence

My stance is to keep an eye on tokenized infrastructure, but not to chase ETH based on headlines alone. On November 2, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) officially announced that the EnsembleTX pilot phase now supports 24/7 settlement of interbank transactions in tokenized deposits using tokenized central bank money. The number of participating banks has risen to 12, and the number of industry pioneers to 20. A separate fintech week announcement on the same day said that the secondary market trial for tokenized Exchange Fund Bills had been completed, while including regulated stablecoins in the trial remains a next step. The former is a capability already enabled in the pilot; the latter involves both completed and incomplete stages. They should not be described together as meaning that all assets are already operating at scale.

Why does this make my ETH watchlist? Settling interbank funds outside traditional business hours could reduce timing mismatches in secondary trading of tokenized assets and may encourage the development of more wallets, issuance, custody, and compliance interfaces. But the HKMA documents do not say that these settlements take place on the Ethereum mainnet, nor do they disclose how much additional ETH fee revenue or institutional ETH buying the pilot has generated. The tokenized product commercialization pathway discussed yesterday by the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission is related to the HKMA’s settlement capabilities, but the specific products, ledgers used, and settlement assets still need to be checked separately. For ETH investors, the transmission chain that can actually be verified is: whether Ethereum or its Layer 2 networks are chosen, whether there is sustained real trading, and whether measurable demand for ETH ultimately results. Without the first two links, grand narratives should not become a reason to buy.

How has the market reacted so far? I just checked Kraken: ETH is around $2,276.94, with a daily open of $2,249.46, an intraday low of $2,237.46, and a high of $2,304.60; the rolling 24-hour low is $2,233.51. The price is above the daily open, but has pulled back from the intraday high. There is currently no evidence that the move was driven by Hong Kong’s settlement announcement. As for U.S. spot ETH funds, Farside reported combined net outflows of $139.7 million on November 2, including $138.3 million in outflows from ETHA. All fund entries for November 3 are still dashes; the automatic total of 0.0 should not be taken to mean that outflows have stopped. The Federal Reserve has held rates in the 3.75%–4% range, so risk assets still face relatively high funding costs.

If I were trading this myself: I would stay out for now, and only consider a small long position in spot, capped at 2% of total capital, with no leverage. My entry trigger would be ETH reclaiming and holding above $2,304.60, then holding that level on a retest, while the complete daily fund flow figures show no further deterioration—or official documents confirming the explicit use of Ethereum for settlement. The words “Hong Kong tailwind” alone are not enough. My first target would be $2,330, where I would sell half the position; I would look for $2,360 with the remainder. I would set a stop-loss below $2,260 and close the entire position if the price falls below $2,237.46. If the pilot produces no evidence of public blockchain adoption, fund outflows continue, or the price falls back below the daily open, I would abandon my bullish plan. Admitting I was wrong when the evidence overturns my thesis matters more than finding excuses for the narrative afterward.

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | When You Refuse to Cut Your Losses, Your Brain Is Lying to You
translatedData.subTitle:
What is someone down 50% on a position looking at? The “all-time high,” telling themselves: “If it gets back to my entry price,
I’ll get out.” Be careful: this thought is driven entirely by attachment, not logic. The market doesn’t know your entry price;
it only responds to supply and demand in the present.

Once you’re stuck holding a position, you’ll automatically seek out good news and tune out bad news. This is called confirmation bias. You’ll think,
“This time is different.” Those five words have burned more money throughout history than any hacker ever has.

The antidote is simple, but hard to follow: before opening a position, write down “under what circumstances the logic behind this trade
fails,” then act when the time comes, regardless of how you feel. Separate your decisions from the act of holding a position, and only then can you see clearly.

title: Misleading Headline Alert: Iran "Concessions" Report Is Unconfirmed, and Crypto Is NOT Pumping
subTitle:
A post circulating claims Al-Araby Al-Jadeed reported US-Iran "concessions" on the nuclear program and frozen funds, and that "Bitcoin & Ethereum are pumping back up." Here's what's actually true.
On the Iran report:
Al-Araby Al-Jadeed (Qatar) did report on Oct 31 that mediators proposed preliminary measures involving Iran's nuclear program, reopening the Strait of Hormuz, and financial incentives, with China and Russia as guarantors . But this was unconfirmed by either government. VP Vance said talks have made "progress" but the US is still demanding a verifiable commitment that Iran won't rebuild its nuclear program . Iran's foreign minister said the final outcome "depends on the US" — no deal has been signed .
On crypto prices:
· BTC: ~$76,455–$76,995, down ~2% on Nov 3. 24H low: $76,498 .
· ETH: ~$2,250–$2,262, down .
There is no pump. BTC is below its 5-day, 10-day, and 30-day moving averages, with spot ETF outflows of $398.6M on Nov 2 adding pressure 
The takeaway: Geopolitical headlines are moving fast and getting distorted. The Iran situation is still a negotiation, not a resolution. And the crypto market is pricing in caution ahead of midterms — not a breakout.

📰 Russian Exchange Makes Its Move at Year-End: What Will Crypto Compliance Look Like?

The Moscow Exchange plans to launch trading in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether on December 1. It will comply with the country’s newly passed investor protection regulations, which set annual purchase limits for ordinary retail investors. This marks another step forward for Russia’s domestic crypto market and the global regulatory landscape.

Why does this news matter?
As Russia’s largest exchange, the Moscow Exchange’s entry into crypto trading means the country is systematically bringing cryptocurrencies into its regulatory framework. This reflects Russia’s aims to reduce its dependence on Western finance, attract capital inflows, and manage financial risks. The investor protection measures in the new law—such as annual purchase caps—are essentially intended to prevent ordinary investors from losing everything amid crypto market volatility. Globally, this continues Russia’s recent approach of “embracing while restricting” crypto regulation, echoing the direction taken by the EU, the US, and others, though the specific implementation details differ considerably.

Market impact
For BTC and ETH, this is a positive catalyst. On the one hand, Russia is a major cryptocurrency-holding country, and the exchange’s official launch could further boost the circulation of Bitcoin and Ethereum in the country and their influence on price formation. On the other hand, the compliance process often boosts market confidence, particularly as major economies gradually accept crypto assets. Historical data shows that liquidity in related assets generally improves after regulatory clarity is established. However, it is worth noting that the Russian market is unique in that it may be somewhat disconnected from international markets. This means that even if domestic activity picks up, international price movements for BTC and ETH will still drive short-term trends.

Trading outlook
I believe the Moscow Exchange’s official launch will provide modest bullish momentum for BTC and ETH, especially in the short term. However, this view assumes that Russia will not subsequently impose more aggressive capital controls to restrict cross-border crypto flows. If that happens, or if the international community further tightens sanctions on Russia’s crypto market, this bullish thesis could be undermined.

📰 俄罗斯交易所年底亮剑：加密货币合规化到底要搞成什么样？

俄罗斯交易所计划在12月1日上线比特币、以太坊和泰达币交易，并会遵循该国新通过的投资者保护法规，给普通散户设定年度买入限额。这对俄罗斯本土加密市场乃至全球监管格局都意味着新的一步。

为什么这条新闻重要？
莫斯科交易所作为俄罗斯规模最大的交易所，其入局加密货币交易意味着该国正在系统性地将加密货币纳入监管框架。这背后是俄罗斯希望降低对西方金融依赖、吸引资本流入、同时控制金融风险的考量。新法规定的投资者保护措施——比如设置年购买上限，本质是为了避免普通投资者在加密市场的大起大落中血本无归。从全球范围看，这延续了俄罗斯近年来在监管上"既拥抱又限制"的思路，与欧盟、美国等加强监管的方向形成呼应，但具体执行细节差异明显。

对市场的影响
对BTC和ETH而言，这是一个正面的催化剂因素。一方面，俄罗斯是全球加密货币重要持有国，交易所的正式上线能进一步促进该国比特币和以太坊的流通和定价权重。另一方面，合规化进程往往伴随着市场信心的提振，尤其是当主要经济体逐步接受加密资产时。历史数据显示，监管清晰化后，相关资产的流动性通常会改善。不过需要注意，俄罗斯市场的特殊性在于其与国际市场的联动可能存在隔离效应，这意味着即使国内市场活跃，BTC和ETH的国际价格走势仍会主导短期方向。

操作思路
我认为莫斯科交易所的正式上线，将给BTC和ETH带来温和的看涨动能，尤其是在短期内。但这个判断的前提是，俄罗斯后续不会采取更激进的资本管制措施来限制加密货币的跨境流动。如果出现这种情况，或者国际社会对俄罗斯加密市场的制裁进一步收紧，这个看涨逻辑可能会被打破。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A Stop-Loss Isn’t an Admission of Failure—it’s the Price of Admission to the Next Opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it this way: a stop-loss is insurance you buy in advance, and the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most level-headed traders I’ve ever met are quicker than anyone to admit when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself:
This is the price of admission, not a verdict.

【The hardest part about ETH isn’t the drop—it’s that no one’s in a hurry to buy】

ETH has fallen 2.3% in a week, and the sentiment index is down to just 26. Most people’s first instinct is to look for support. I’d rather start by asking: after a drop like this, is anyone really willing to buy?

ETF funds are pulling out. Ether funds saw record net outflows of $1.61 billion in a single month, yet the market hasn’t crashed—it’s just grinding sideways. Bitmine keeps buying ETH, and its holdings are now close to 5% of the supply. Tom Lee even argued that ETH’s decline after the Binance hack showed the market was more resilient. It sounds encouraging, but when you look at the business logic, one side is a steady outflow of funds while the other is a company continually adding to its holdings. Whose buying power will last longer? The answer isn’t so reassuring.

Meanwhile, an EU-based entity reportedly lost $106 million after an exchange account was compromised. The stolen funds passed through ETH, instant swaps, and Monero. ETH itself wasn’t stolen, but the instinct that “holding ETH is safer” clearly doesn’t hold up under repeated headlines like this. The ones truly affected are holders, trading platforms, and projects that depend on ecosystem activity for their livelihood.

I panic-sold once in 2017. What I learned afterward wasn’t how to predict price movements, but not to mistake other people’s panic for my own cue to act. The price is now around $2,278, and both $2,190 and $2,341 look awfully familiar. I really am itching to trade, but this time I stayed out.

Are you riding this one out, selling at a loss, or already itching to trade?

【ETH最难受的，不是跌，是没人急着接】

ETH从一周跌2.3%到情绪指数只剩26，很多人第一反应是找支撑。我反而想先问一句：跌成这样，真有人愿意接盘吗？

ETF资金在撤。Ether基金单月净流出创纪录的16.1亿美元，行情却没崩，只是横着磨。Bitmine继续买ETH，手里的筹码已接近供应量的5%，Tom Lee还把币安被盗后的ETH下跌解释成市场更有韧性。听着挺提气，可真落到商业逻辑，一个是资金持续离场，一个是企业不断增持，谁的购买力更持久？答案没那么轻松。

另一边，欧盟某实体疑因交易所账户被盗损失1.06亿美元，赃款经过ETH、即时兑换和门罗币。ETH本身没被偷，但“持有ETH会更安全”这种直觉，显然经不起这种新闻反复敲打。真正受影响的，是持币者、交易平台，还有靠生态活跃吃饭的项目方。

我2017年割过一次，后来学到的不是预测涨跌，而是别把别人的恐慌当自己的指令。现在价格2278美元附近，2190和2341这两个位置谁看着都眼熟。手痒是真的，但这次真没上。

Checked again at 20:52 before publication: BTC around 77,478, about -0.4% over 24 hours, with a daily high of 78,254 and low of 76,389; $ETH  around 2,287, essentially flat over 24 hours; SOL around 93.3, about -0.8%. BTC open interest was around 3.375 million contracts, or about $2.61 billion; ETH was around 6.31 million contracts, or about $1.44 billion. Both were slightly lower than in the morning—leverage is shrinking, not building. BTC 21根小时线压在77,620下方、晚间从76,389低点弹回77,478：收复位仍是今夜第一道题

先说主线走到哪了。$BTC 早盘是9根小时线收在77,620下方，午间延长到13根，到19:00收盘已经是连续第21根收在这个位下方。中间不是没动静：14:00低点打到76,389，跌破了早盘盯的76,664，但没一口气滑下去，晚间又弹了回来。我的读法就一句话：下破兑现了，反弹也来了，收复还没来。

数字都是今晚实测的。发前复核20:52：BTC约77,478，24小时约-0.4%，今天高78,254、低76,389；$ETH 约2,287，24小时基本走平；SOL约93.3，约-0.8%。OKX永续交叉偏差都在0.1%以内。资金费率BTC、ETH都是约0.01%，近零，没逼空也没恐慌踩踏的拥挤结构；未平仓BTC约337.5万张、约26.1亿美元，ETH约631万张、约14.4亿美元，都比早上略降——杠杆在缩，不是加。今日媒体转引CoinGlass的24小时爆仓约3.66亿美元、多头占约83.8%，这是白天口径，晚间暂未见更新。

山寨只提两句。HOT晚间又加速：19:00收盘0.000538，量能约217万USDT，收上了中午稿说的0.000483，20:00盘中摸到0.000596，但这根还没收盘，不算确认，今天它已发过一篇，这里只作背景。BMT盘中0.02701、ZRO盘中1.838也都在冲，同样未收盘、也没拿到今天的新催化剂，追之前先等收盘。弱侧没变：HUMA盘中刚回到0.020上方，同样未收盘；TRX还在0.322，离0.34远着呢。

title: ETHGas: Bringing Wall Street to Ethereum Through Advance Block Reservations
subTitle:
🚀 ETHGas: Bringing Wall Street to Ethereum

ETHGas is aiming to bring Wall Street-style block trading to the public Ethereum network by introducing advance block reservations. This new approach could allow institutions and large traders to secure future blockspace in advance, making Ethereum transactions more predictable and potentially improving market efficiency.

However, there is one important concern: validators who fail to deliver on their commitments currently face no financial compensation requirement under the service.

This raises questions about accountability, reliability, and trust. While ETHGas could open new opportunities for institutional participation in Ethereum, its long-term success will depend on how effectively it addresses these risks.

Can ETHGas become a major step toward institutional adoption of Ethereum, or will validator accountability remain a challenge?

以太坊市场深度分析：机构增持与ETF流出的拉锯战

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月三日上午十一时，以太坊现货报价两千二百六十四美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之零点八。从小时K线来看，ETH在两千两百五十美元附近获得支撑后展开反弹，最高触及两千两百八十六美元，随后小幅回落至当前水平。价格目前运行在布林带中轨两千两百五十八美元上方，接近上轨两千两百七十五美元，短期走势偏强但面临阻力。

以太坊当前面临的核心矛盾是机构现货增持与ETF资金流出的对抗。一方面，某大型机构买家在购入八千五百七十三枚ETH后再度增持五千枚ETH，总持仓达到六百零六万五千枚ETH，占流通供应量的百分之四点九六，这一持续增持行为为现货市场提供了坚实的需求支撑。另一方面，现货以太坊ETF连续录得净流出，十一月二日单日流出一点三九七亿美元，三十天内基金转出超过五十八万枚ETH，机构层面的资金撤离对价格形成压制。

币安完成零知识证明储备验证对ETH市场信心有所提振。验证确认ETH等主要资产实现一比一足额储备，降低了交易对手风险传染的担忧。同时，巴西最大加密交易所Mercado Bitcoin遭遇的四千九百万美元黑客攻击事件也提醒市场，安全问题仍是行业面临的系统性风险。

二、技术指标解读

综合信号方面，十五个因子中九个做多、五个做空、一个中性，做多比例同样为百分之六十。综合指标值为一点零三二，信号偏向多头，整体胜率为百分之八十五点一一，其中做多胜率为百分之七十六，做空胜率为百分之九十五点四五，信号质量较高。

均线系统呈现收敛态势。七日均线两千两百六十四美元与二十五日均线两千两百六十三美元几乎持平，九十九日均线在两千两百六十美元附近，三条均线高度粘合，这通常预示着即将出现方向性突破。指数移动平均线方面，EMA七两千两百六十七美元刚刚上穿EMA二十五的两千两百六十四美元，形成短期金叉信号，但价格仍受压于EMA九十九的两千两百七十二美元。

MACD指标持续改善，柱状图连续五个周期扩大，最新值为正三点二六，MACD线从负五点六四回升至负零点二九，即将突破零轴。若MACD成功转正，将确认短期趋势由空转多。RSI六达到七十三点九八，进入偏强区域，RSI十二为六十二点六八，中期动能同步走强。

KDJ指标中K值八十二，D值七十二，J值一百零二，三线均处于高位但未出现死叉，多头格局延续。威廉指标为负九点一九，接近超买区域。随机RSI维持在九十三以上的高位，短线存在回调压力但趋势仍然向上。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前的核心叙事围绕机构积累展开。大型买家持续增持至流通量的近百分之五，这一行为本身就是对ETH长期价值的强烈背书。SEC近期明确治理代币如UNI一般不构成证券，这一监管利好对整个DeFi生态形成正面推动，ETH作为DeFi基础设施的核心资产也将间接受益。

从链上数据来看，CEX出现大额净流入，净买入达到四千五百一十八万美元，推动价格从两千两百四十六美元低点快速反弹。OBV指标从负三十二万八千改善至负三十一万七千，卖压正在减轻。

风险方面需要关注几个因素。首先是黑客洗钱带来的链上抛压，多起大型黑客事件的非法收益被转换为ETH，形成持续的卖出压力。其次是价格接近EMA九十九的关键阻力位，若无法有效突破可能引发技术性回调。第三是整体加密市场的安全事件频发，二零二六年黑客损失已超过八十七亿美元，是二零二五年全年的三倍以上，行业安全形势严峻。

短期操作建议关注两千两百五十美元的支撑和两千两百八十六美元的阻力。若ETH能有效突破两千两百七十二美元的EMA九十九阻力，有望打开上行空间至两千三百五十美元区域。反之，若跌破两千两百五十美元支撑，可能回测两千两百四十美元的布林带下轨。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。
